videoDetails.title: Tell your agents to CARE about the codebase
videoDetails.shortDescription:
AI agents excel at tactical programming but struggle with strategic thinking. In this video, learn why agents need your guidance to care about long-term code quality, refactoring, and architecture—and how to make them brilliant at it.
